From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: Deployment boundary & evidence onboarding for private/VPC deployment

Hi Priya / Mike —

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the technical/compliance side. High-level takeaways from our conversation: 

- MedNova is evaluating a private/VPC deployment (customer-managed VPC) for PHI workloads with a possible air-gapped POC for a limited environment.
- Primary compliance drivers: HIPAA (PHI), GDPR (EU data subjects), and an expected SOC 2 Type II attestation during procurement.
- Network isolation and evidence (network diagrams, firewall rules, ingress/egress controls) are critical for your security board.

Requested immediate items from our side: 
1) We will share a vendor security questionnaire (spreadsheet) and a blank network-diagram template you can populate.
2) Can you confirm the expected timeline for SOC 2 evidence (attestation report or timeline to produce)?
3) Please identify any internal reviewers for the architecture deep-dive (network/security ops, data privacy, compliance counsel).

Next steps we propose: 
- Sean to share the questionnaire + diagram template (attached).
- Schedule a technical deep-dive (45–60 min) next week to walk through the network boundary, routing, and KMS approach. Suggested attendees: your infra lead, security, and one compliance owner; our attendees: Karthik (SE), Lauren (SecOps), Marissa (CS).

Attachments: redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet) | network-diagram-template.pdf (blank diagram)

If this matches what you expect, can you reply with: (a) who from MedNova will attend the technical deep-dive; (b) availability windows next week; (c) any immediate blockers for sharing SOC 2 evidence?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Thanks Sean — helpful summary. A few quick notes from MedNova: 

- SOC 2: we have a Type II report in the current cycle but the full attestation won't be available until mid-January; we can provide interim evidence (control descriptions, latest auditor findings) next week.
- HIPAA/GDPR: compliance team confirmed PHI will remain in our VPC and MedNova will require BAA language; we will surface required contract terms separately with procurement.
- Air-gapped POC: possible but will be limited to non-production data or synthetic data initially. Needs sign-off from infra and legal.

Attendees for the technical deep-dive: 
- Mike Chen (Infra lead)
- Priya Kapoor (Security/Compliance lead)
- I'll loop in legal if we get to contract items.

Availability: Tue/Wed next week (Dec 8/9) between 9–12 PT.

We can accept the questionnaire but will need a short form first (3–4 pages) for procurement; full spreadsheet is fine for the technical team. I will confirm which artifacts we can share before the meeting.

Best,
Priya Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | MedNova Health

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Priya / team — looping in a few specific evidence asks and technical clarifications from SecOps so MedNova can prepare ahead of the deep-dive. Below are the items we'll look for and why we need them. Please flag anything you cannot provide.

1) SOC 2 / control evidence (if attestation pending):
   - Control narratives for logical access, change management, incident response (we can accept auditor letters or control matrices).
   - Evidence of periodic access reviews and privileged access processes.

2) Data residency & GDPR:
   - Confirmation of where PHI/eu-data will be stored (region/az) and any data-export controls.

3) HIPAA / BAA:
   - Desired BAA terms or a list of non-negotiables from legal to help our contracts team scope the BAA.

4) KMS / key management:
   - KMS provider (AWS KMS / customer-managed HSM), key rotation policy, separation-of-duties details.

5) Audit / logging evidence:
   - Where logs are retained, retention windows, and whether logs are accessible to MedNova (e.g., aggregated into your Splunk/CloudWatch).

6) Network isolation & air-gapped asks:
   - Populate the attached network-diagram-template.pdf with the planned boundary lines: subnets, NAT/egress, private endpoints, bastion/Jumphosts.
   - Describe expected egress patterns (allowed domains/IP ranges) and whether there will be any service endpoints that need outbound internet access for model updates.
   - If considering an air-gapped POC: describe the approach to model updates and how artifacts/artifacts transfer will be secured (sneakernet, signed packages, ephemeral import host).

7) Evidence / artifacts we commonly accept:
   - Network diagrams, firewall rules export (iptable/sg lists), KMS policy snippets, auditor cover letters, control matrices.

If MedNova wants a shorter procurement-friendly packet first, we can produce a 1–2 page compliance summary for procurement containing high-level controls and our SOC 2 timeline. The technical deep-dive can then focus on the diagram and KMS/egress specifics.

Action items for MedNova before the deep-dive:
- Confirm attendees and preferred slot (Priya suggested Dec 8/9 morning PT).
- Populate the diagram template with a draft boundary sketch (even hand-drawn scan is fine).
- Share any procurement-level questions so we can prepare the short packet.

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

If anything urgent comes up before Dec 8, reply-all and we'll triage. Looking forward to the deep-dive.
